comment: Peak RSS budgets (MiB) per heavy test process. Healthy peaks measured 2026-10-20; budget is about 1.25x peak, rounded up. A file over budget fails. TT-1 (2026-10-22): world-stream peaked at 1286 MiB with three heavy files running at once (1216 MiB alone at root), and caves-reef-isles-retreat at 1009 MiB alone at root (98% of 1024), so both were raised. Budgets cover each file's whole process tree (TT-1 R1-1): regions-bake's terrain bake runs in child processes and peaks at 1469 MiB as a tree (2026-10-22), so it gets 1920.
exclusiveComment: These files assert elapsed time (build cost or per-step query cost), so the heavy runner runs them last, one at a time, in a timing phase with no other heavy file beside them, and reports the CPU wait each one saw (STEW-2).
clockWithoutBoundComment: These files read a clock only to report a time; they assert no bound, so they share the pool. Every heavy file that reads a clock is in one of the two lists, or the tier refuses to run.
